value.rationale: The motivating three-genotype error-threshold theorem imposes identical synthesis delays. Unequal delays break the population-normalization identity at the separate delayed arguments; deriving a quantified asynchronous mass floor restores a robust extinction statement. The criterion is expressed in the spread of lag times, not their arbitrarily large common magnitude, and supplies a rigorous global exponential rate for arbitrary normalized histories with seasonal rates. This is a structurally motivated open domain of the model, rather than a renamed ODE or small numerical improvement. Its bound is conservative and does not purport to optimize threshold or predict clinical data.
